verdict.rationale: Sentry documents OTLP ingestion of traces and logs and a Trace Explorer for viewing span samples/attributes, and Seer Agent claims to 'find the right telemetry' to answer questions, implying some cross-telemetry correlation. However, there is no explicit documentation of a UI workflow to jump directly from a trace span to correlated logs and metrics, nor any mention of metrics correlation specifically. Missing for 10: explicit metrics ingestion/correlation, a documented span-to-logs/metrics navigation feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
